written_before: the ablation was first run (one dry run on 2026-11-10, after this rule was frozen, to check the kit); merged on main before scripts/ablation.py was added; never changed after
split_used: validation only (2,275 sentences, 10 companies); the test split stays unread until Session 12

features.word: TF-IDF word 1-2-grams, min_df 2, at most 30000 features, sublinear tf
features.char: TF-IDF character 3-5-grams inside word boundaries, min_df 3, at most 25000 features, sublinear tf
features.hybrid: word and char together (the shipped model)

cut_offs.per_category: one cut-off per category from 0.10 to 0.90 in steps of 0.05, tuned on validation; measured honestly with leave-one-company-out
cut_offs.fixed_0.5: 0.5 for every category (nothing tuned, so the validation score is already honest)

grid.classifier: one logistic regression per category (liblinear, C 1.0, seed 641), trained on the train split only

measure: honest validation macro-F1 over the 8 categories (leave-one-company-out for per_category, plain for fixed_0.5)

simpler_order: features: word or char before hybrid
rule.text: Keep the shipped configuration unless another configuration's honest macro-F1 is at least 0.02 higher. If one or more are, choose the highest; among configurations within 0.005 of the highest, choose the simplest. A switch is shipped at the Session 12 freeze, not during Session 11.
rule.if_keep: KEEP the shipped model for the final release
rule.if_switch: SWITCH to {name} at the Session 12 freeze

reported_only: micro-F1 and flags per 100 sentences for every configuration
macro-F1 on the Session 10 fresh documents (strict answers) for every configuration; these labels were not made independently (reports/session10.md), so they decide nothing
training seconds per configuration (printed only, not saved, because they differ on every laptop)
sanity_check: the retrained shipped configuration must reproduce the committed validation predictions of the product model (experiments/session07/tuned/predictions.jsonl); otherwise the ablation stops
not_included: a contextual model (for example sentence embeddings): it cannot be installed offline on every laptop, so it is not a candidate
